data.narrative:
Rune Technologies is a Series A-stage defense and security company founded by David Tuttle and Peter Goldsborough that has raised $20M+ to date. The valuation analysis relies on a peer set of 10 comparable companies—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private—operating in the same sector and stage, including Stark Defence, Singularity, NODA AI, Anduril Industries, and Helsing.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $20M raised as a valuation proxy and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical for Series A advancement, yielding $40M. Peer-median analysis across three same-sector, same-stage comparables (Stark Defence at $4.0B, Singularity at $400M, and NODA AI at $125M) produces a median valuation of $400M, though the peer range spans $125M to $4.0B, indicating substantial dispersion. The stage-progression method reflects Rune's current capital position conservatively, while the peer-median approach captures market precedent but is sensitive to the wide range of outcomes in early-stage defense tech.

Synthesizing both methods produces a triangulated range of $34M (low) to $460M (high), with a median of $220M. This wide band reflects material uncertainty around Rune's technological differentiation and market traction relative to both earlier-stage and more mature peers. Validation of assumptions around product-market fit and capital efficiency will be critical to narrowing the range.
